c.v: ESP32-S3's RTC FAST Memory can be further split into 2 regions.
Each split region can be configured independently with different access by configuring respective registers (PMS_CORE_m_PIF_PMS_CONSTRAN_n_REG).
Note that split regions can be configured independently for CPU0 and CPU1 and for the Secure World and Non-secure World.
The Register for configuring the split line is described below:

blocks.caption: Table 15.3-12. Split RTC FAST Memory into the Higher Region and the Lower Region

c.v: 1 The offset from the RTC FAST Memory base address should be used when configuring the split address.
For example, if you want to split the RTC FAST Memory at 0x600F_F000, then write 0x1000 to this register.
Access configuration for the higher and lower regions of the RTC FAST Memory is described below:

blocks.caption: Table 15.3-13. Access Configuration to the RTC FAST Memory

c.v: B For example, configuring this field to 0b101 indicates CPU's peripheral (PIF) bus is granted with the instruction execution and read accesses but not the read access from the Secure World to the higher region of RTC FAST Memory.
